1use super::super::GameEnv;
2use crate::events::Event;
3use crate::state::StageStatus;
4
5impl GameEnv {
6    pub(in crate::env) fn resolve_stand_phase(&mut self, player: u8) {
7        let p = player as usize;
8        for slot in &mut self.state.players[p].stage {
9            if slot.card.is_some() {
10                slot.status = StageStatus::Stand;
11                slot.has_attacked = false;
12            }
13            slot.power_mod_battle = 0;
14        }
15        self.mark_player_slot_power_dirty(player);
16        self.mark_continuous_modifiers_dirty();
17        self.log_event(Event::Stand { player });
18    }
19}
